scenarios.text: Tim Cook is the chief executive officer of Apple Inc., headquartered in Cupertino, California.

scenarios.name: medium
scenarios.text: Tim Cook is the chief executive officer of Apple Inc., headquartered in Cupertino, California. Before joining Apple in 1998 he worked at Compaq and IBM. Apple was founded by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne in 1976 and today produces the iPhone, the Mac and the Apple Watch. In 2014 Apple acquired Beats Electronics, the headphone company co-founded by Dr. Dre and Jimmy Iovine, for three billion dollars.
